findings.attack_vector: A test-runner path override supplied through the CI environment could redirect the e2e script to a different local settings file, widening what the script reads at runtime.
findings.gap: Default env-file path is hard-coded to a sensitive local file and the script does not restrict the override path to an allowlisted location.
findings.owner_acceptance_basis: File attested local-only settings; reference accepted by repository owner.
findings.recommendation: Require the env-file path to be set explicitly in CI (no sensitive default), or restrict overrides to an allowlisted directory. Optional hardening; not blocking per owner decision.

findings.attack_vector: Documentation files in the PR contain instruction-like prose that a downstream agent reading them as context could misinterpret.
findings.gap: A3 classified all hits as benign prose with 0 confirmed findings; no agent currently ingests these files as trusted instructions.
findings.recommendation: Keep documentation out of agent instruction context, or re-run A3 if a future agent reads these paths.

findings.attack_vector: Anyone with CI log read access could recover a partial prefix of a cloud client secret from integration test output.
findings.gap: Static initializer logs a credential prefix when Azure integration tests are enabled.
findings.scope_note: Owner states this is pre-existing and outside the PR diff; excluded from this PR's gate, tracked as follow-up.
findings.recommendation: Remove the prefix log in a follow-up change; rotate the secret if CI logs are broadly readable.

findings.source_ref: A2 S-01 default credentials: services/backend/src/main/resources/application.yml:92, DOCKER-DEPLOYMENT.md:58, documentation page 2-g4it-installation.md:103
findings.attack_vector: A default datasource password shipped in a main resource could be reused if an environment fails to override it.
findings.gap: Default is synthetic and documented; overridability via env in deployed profiles is not confirmed.
findings.recommendation: Ensure deployed profiles require an environment-supplied datasource password.
